findings.finding: The committed `native selectedMedia caller carries a safe image timeout into the receipt` test manually calls retainScrapeMediaFailure from its own test catch. It does not execute or assert the production top-level catch/writer wiring, so deleting `retainScrapeMediaFailure(report, error)` from scrape-guest-native-acceptance.mjs leaves all four committed tests green.
findings.evidence: Verified in scratch: extracted and executed the actual production catch and writer with the actual observer; the receipt contained scrape_media_failure. Then removed only the production retention call from that extracted catch. The receipt assertion failed with scrape_media_failure_missing. The committed focused suite itself does not run that production catch, so this mutant is not guarded in CI.
